answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 1247 Country: Canada Title: I understand sending salam to our beloved nabi (Sallallahu 'alaihi wa sallam) but what does it mean to send salat as well? You said in a response to my question (Fatwa ID 619) that the word sallam in Sallallahu 'alaihi wa sallam have the words salah and salam. Please explain in detail. Question: Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem. Assalaamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu Respected Ulama of Deoband, I understand sending salam to our beloved nabi (Sallallahu 'alaihi wa sallam) but what does it mean to send salat as well? You said in a response to my question (Fatwa ID 619) that the word sallam in Sallallahu 'alaihi wa sallam have the words salah and salam. Please explain in detail. Answer ID: 1247 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 768/768/J) Salat means ?blessings? ( durood ) and sending salat means reciting words of blessings for the Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi wa sallam). In Surah Al-ahzab , Allah has ordained Muslims to send salam and salat at the Prophet: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا (Allah and His angels send blessings on the prophet: O ye that believe! send ye blessings on him, and salute Him with all respect. 33/56) Now, one is allowed to send only salat as in the Durood Ibrahimi ( اللھم صل علی محمد و علی آل محمد کما صلیت علی ابراھیم ) or send only salam (as السلام علیک ایھا النبی ورحمۃ اللہ و برکاتہ ), or one can combine both salam and salat as in صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم . All the three forms are allowed but it is better to combine both salam and salat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
